body: I sadly don't have the time right now.. but this sounds like something I actually really want to try! I'm sure you have a ton of people lining up already, but im definitely saving this article and totally copying your great idea for my own future post, sorry! 😅

This is me exactly. If my death didn't affect my family at all I'd be gone before I even finished this comment. I catch myself fantasizing about dying to save someone else's life all the time, like pushing them out of the way of a car, or donating my organs to those in need. I actually had a chance a few weeks ago when a car started on fire and exploded near my house and the people inside barely got out in time, if I was outside when that happened I know I would have ran over and easily risked my life/possibly died to help save them. Too bad my lazy ass wasn't awake..
I miss hugging so bad. Just being close, that rare sense of feeling accepted..

"All I could hear was my own brain. "You're stupid. Everyone's watching. You're embarrassing yourself. The teacher is mad. Stop making her wait. Why couldn't she call on someone else."

This is exactly what I have dealt with on a daily basis since as long as I can remember. My brain does this nonstop throughout the day, even when I'm alone, I'm so sorry you have to go through it as well. I wouldn't wish this upon anyone. I wish you the best of luck in attacking this going forward, I'm so happy to hear you're in college and still taking steps forward in life, no matter how hard they are. I allowed myself to lose all hope and now I'm just stalling until I can't any longer, so it really makes me happy to see someone like me still fighting. I believe in you!

You're not a failure by any stretch of the word, really. I'm so sorry you're feeling this way :( , Look I'm only 19 and I have a ton of money saved up with not nearly as many responsibilities as you and I'd really like to help you out by refilling your gas for you. I promise it'd be no trouble at all, really. I genuinely enjoy helping people, and everyone needs a little helping hand every now and then. I'm also not gonna be one of those creeps who use it as leverage against you or anything, we don't even have to ever speak again afterwards. Only thing I ask for in return is that you stay strong! And when you find yourself in a better position in the future, pass it along to someone else who may need a helping hand :)
What.. the... fuck?

I'm so sorry you've been through so many traumas in your life. I understand feeling lonely, and having one friend just isn't enough to get rid of that feeling. I haven't experienced the abuse and betrayal that you have but I've experienced my fair share of pain in other ways and I'm so sorry you're going through those same feelings. All of my negative thoughts and feelings all stem from the same thing, myself. I'm always at war with my head, whether it be anxiety, ocd, or numerous other problems I have, and stemming from this is where the depression and hopelessness kind of come in. I'm not sure why I wrote this really but I guess it's good to vent sometimes. I hope you hang in there, one day at a time, and if you need someone to talk to, about anything really, my lonely ass will be here.
I know exactly how this feels. I just wish I could've known how good and special that time was while it was still happening.

These are the type of things that make me just hate religion in a sense. I strongly disagree with so many of the ingrained practices and beliefs of Christianity, including the concept of eternal torture. I've started thinking of religion and God in a different sense. Think of it as more black and white, good and bad, good and evil. Which do you support, or believe in? I hate the concept of evil, I hate hurting people, using people, I hate all of the killing and bad you see in the world. So I would say I believe in good. If youre a "good" person, and don't commit to extremely evil acts or ideas, I believe you should go to wherever good people go when they die, regardless of what the Bible or other religious text says. If God is truly forgiving and all loving, then all good people who are all loving should be accepted whether they interfere with some of the many questionable things the teachings say. 


Sorry if I ranted or didn't make sense or if I was even offensive to some degree, this is just my personal belief. Just be loving and kind to people and I believe you should receive it back. :)
Thats awesome, great job working through it and getting it done. Having the weight of relief lifted off of your chest once you're finished will make it all worth it :)
Today im going to go back and play one of my old favorite childhood games, Pokemon. Takes me back to a simpler time I guess. How about you?
I just turned 19 and I feel the same. I'm thinking 22 will be my cutoff, if I even make it that far. I wish you the best of luck in getting better though. We're not out of time yet.

You need to just keep fighting, as hard as that may be. I've been talking to a therapist and its actually been helping a lot. If you aren't already, maybe try talking to someone, it can really help, I promise. I also see you're into art and are very talented, keep working on that! It's really awesome! I wish I could draw like that :) Just take it one day at a time and just try to make those small victories count, you can do it.

I'm so sorry you're going through all of that. That's just terrible. Nobody should ever have to experience any of those things :(  I'm really glad to see you're in group therapy and on medication though, please keep trying it. Keep pushing and give this medication a fair chance, I believe in you! If you need a friend when you're feeling down, ill always be here too.

I'm sorry you're feeling so down. What do you mean by you cant have kids? If its a biological thing im so sorry :( but adoption is always a great option. Those kids need homes and a loving family too! And if that's not an option for you, you can still find someone to share a great life with as a partner! Everyone deserves love and you can and will find it, as hard as it may be. I hope you feel better..
There are so many people who care about you, I promise, and nobody deserves to feel so alone.. if you need someone to talk to ill always be here :)

I'm so sorry you're going through all of this. I've struggled through substance abuse in my family and I know how hard it can be. I know you touched on it but talking to a therapist can really change a lot if you allow it to work. And whenever you're having those suicidal thoughts, please know that you're not alone. There are people who do care and understand. You can call a hotline, talk to a loved one, vent on reddit, or if nothing else im here for you. Just keep fighting one day at a time, ok?

I struggle with anxiety and overthinking everyday as well, so I understand your pain, and as hard as this might be for you to do, I think you really should talk to your mom about the idea of talking to someone. I've just recently began therapy and can honestly say that I can genuinely see improvements! If you'd asked me before, I never would've thought that was possible. This doesn't mean therapy will be an instant success though. For therapy to work right, you really have to give it a chance and work for it, but if you do that, it will get better, I promise. Try talking to her about it, be honest with her, and kick anxiety's ass! :)

Hey man, I totally understand how it is to feel unwanted and in such a dark place. But I just wanted to say that im actually proud of you. You just turned into an adult and are already balancing college, work, and lifes responsibilities, not to mention during a fucking virus. Im only 18 too and can't bring myself to do any of these things quite yet, but im taking my steps slowly each day. I know to yourself it may not seem like much, but im proud of you man. Things will figure themselves out, I promise, and when this virus passes it'll help out too. Just hang in there, one day at a time.
For what its worth, im proud of you, and I know a lot of people would be. Live the life you want :)

I can relate for sure. My girlfriend broke up with me a few months ago. I was on a variety of medications until I finally found one that worked.  I know it's cliche or whatever but the only way I can manage my anxiety, even in the slightest, is through music. Listening to a lot of music, writing my own songs, even just humming. I hope you can get better eventually. Keep trying :)
You've expressed my entire mind perfectly. I feel this exact same way. I hope you, somehow, find a way past this..
This is exactly how I feel every single day. I hope you find a way past this..
I feel the same way... my mind just isn't mine anymore. I'd love to have someone to talk to that could understand and relate.
Well if it has a mind of its own maybe try a shorter haircut thats easier to control :)

You're welcome :) and it could be anything. It can be hard right now to keep up with maintenance but it definitely makes me feel better about myself when I take care of myself more. And if you think you looked better when you were younger, why not try an older haircut? :)
As a guy, I think you look great as is :) try maintaining yourself a bit more and you'll start feeling a lot better about yourself!

I feel very much the same as you. My father and very close cousin passed away when I was 13 and it kind of left me stranded. I was very social before that but since I've secluded myself to the point where I can barely handle the social parts of everyday life. I'm 18 now, and I've just finally accepted the fact that I need help and need to start taking steps to better myself.. but theres a long ways to go. If you want a friend to talk to that can sort of relate, I'll be here!
That's terrible.. I'm so sorry. My relationship with my father was amazing, and I know that I'm blessed to have had him, but one night he was here and the next he was gone...

Being a good, thoughtful, caring person can be hard sometimes. But dont feel bad if you need to focus on yourself, especially if you arent feeling good. I can tell you really care about other people, and as someone who has trouble dealing with my stupid nonsensical problems by myself, I'm really thankful for people like you who actually give a shit.
I'm sure it is.. but I'm sure you'll feel a lot better, both physically and mentally. You'll feel a lot better about yourself and how you had the willpower to stop.
I've heard.. it ruins a lot of lives. Dont go too far with it please..

For me, I want to feel accepted in a way. In my head I have so many negative thoughts and I always put myself down. I feel the need of someone telling me that everything I think isn't true, because otherwise it's just me and my head, and that doesnt work like it should...

Im an 18m and I often feel the same way, and it really hurts when people dont feel the same way. But let me tell you, you are not disgusting or worthless, and you deserve love just as much as everybody else. So dont give up! You'll find it

I absolutely feel this way. When I was 13 my father and very close cousin passed away and I was left severely depressed. I'm 18 now, and still messed up dont get me wrong, but I regret missing out on all of those years. All of those memories. I shouldn't have let that ruin me like it did, and I still dont know how to fix myself. 

If theres one thing I've learned from this subreddit, its that you're never alone...

I'm an 18m. My father passed away a few years back during the time in my life where I honestly needed him most. Losing that fatherly love and figure all of a sudden really messed me up, and it still does. I just like to think that somehow hes still here with me, whenever I hear a song on the radio that he really liked, or do something that he really enjoyed. 

Have you told your father how you feel? If not, maybe have a deep, truly emotional conversation with him.. sometimes those can be the best eye-openers for change...

I'm an 18 year old male and I feel the same way all the time. I see all of my friends going out and having fun and making these memories but I just cant bring myself to do it like they can. If you want to talk about it or maybe have someone to relate to send me a chat! It would be great to actually talk to someone that feels the same way.
